walkthroughs.title: W1 · The Minimal ReAct Loop: Evolution of the messages List
walkthroughs.subtitle: The skeleton of every agent — what happens each round, what stays in the trajectory
walkthroughs.summary: Walk the real main loop from the ablation suite round by round, watching messages grow from two entries to task completion.

walkthroughs.title: W2 · Six Context Compression Strategies
walkthroughs.subtitle: Compression is not "compress when it overflows" — summarized knowledge is often more usable than the raw form
walkthroughs.summary: A six-arm comparison on one research task: implementation details of cutting tokens by 75%, from no compression to contextual compression.

walkthroughs.title: W3 · The Agent Status Bar, Five Pieces
walkthroughs.subtitle: Distill implicit state scattered across the trajectory into explicit knowledge — injected via a user slot without breaking the cache
walkthroughs.summary: Implementation and injection points of five techniques: timestamp, tool counter, TODO, detailed errors, and system state.

walkthroughs.title: W4 · Coding Agent: Seven Tools and Environment Awareness
walkthroughs.subtitle: Dynamic environment injection and test-driven completion — software-engineering infrastructure naturally forms a Harness
walkthroughs.summary: Implementation notes on the run main loop, git state injection, and the dual-provider adapter.

walkthroughs.title: W5 · Flux: an Event-Driven Async Runtime
walkthroughs.subtitle: The synchronous training paradigm vs the asynchronous deployment reality — cancel, queue, and batch strategies for interruptions
walkthroughs.summary: How events are routed by urgency, how interruptions land safely in the trajectory, and how batched events stay neither lost nor scrambled.

walkthroughs.title: W6 · The Three-Layer Trajectory Verifier
walkthroughs.subtitle: Outcome, process, and quality signals — continual evolution starts with knowing which layer failed
walkthroughs.summary: The layered implementation of an environment-outcome verifier, a process-rules verifier, and an LLM rubric quality verifier.

walkthroughs.title: W7 · Propose, Verify, Canvass, Roll Back: an Agent Modifying Its Own Code
walkthroughs.subtitle: Self-modification, converted into an auditable software release process
walkthroughs.summary: The full chain from failure trajectories to minimal patches, AST-plus-behavior verification, and checklist-gated staged rollout.

walkthroughs.title: W8 · The Message Bus and Cascading Termination
walkthroughs.subtitle: Ten parallel agents in a preemptive search — how "first verified success" settles
walkthroughs.summary: Envelope messages, subscribe-and-forward, interruptible worker waits, and cascading termination.
